Linda, we truly appreciate your five-star rating for Ju Ju's Pet Grooming. Even without additional comments, your support means a lot to our team, and we look forward to providing excellent care for your pet again soon!

Juju’s is a very clean pet grooming salon, and they did an excellent job on my dog. I would recommend them highly. Although expensive I take my dog here because it is immaculately clean and they’re the only ones that seem to be able to cut his toenails properly. Also, I don’t have to leave my dog there all day long. They usually finish him within an hour and a half to two hours as requested.
Cindy was amazing with taking care of my baby Bentley! He looks and smells amazing!

Where do I even start with JuJu Pet? Cindy has been grooming my cocker-poo, Xing Xing, ever since she was just a little pup, and I honestly wouldn’t trust anyone else with her. Over the years, Cindy and her crew have always treated Xing Xing like family, and that kind of care and consistency means a lot to us.

Every grooming appointment has been a great experience. Xing Xing always comes home looking adorable, clean, and happy. You can really tell the staff genuinely loves animals and takes pride in what they do. They’re patient, caring, and always make both pets and owners feel comfortable.

Another thing I really appreciate is how reasonable their pricing is, especially considering the quality of care and service they provide. They also offer boarding, which has been incredibly convenient for us over the years. It’s hard to find a place that is both trustworthy and affordable, but JuJu Pet has definitely been that place for our family.

If you’re looking for a dependable groomer who truly cares about your pets, I highly recommend Cindy and everyone at JuJu Pet. We’ve been loyal customers for years and will continue coming back!

I’ve been to this dog salon before where a good job was done on my dog. The second time around was awful. His ears were chopped (not cut) horribly and his nails weren’t even barely cut, and anal expression not done. When I came to pick my dog up the owner states she was unable to cut my dogs nails well, or do anal expression because he  wouldn’t allow her to (reasonable, but questionable because they’ve did it before & he’s never had an issue before at other places or even here) I said that I understood and was there any way I didn’t have to pay for those services (since they were not completed) she informed me even though the services weren’t completed she would not take them off of the total price ! Will never take my pet back here ever again ! Also lady was rude the entire time.
Excellent and quick service… in and out in 1.5 hours

Just by looking at the reviews and calling to set an appointment I got bad vibes off this place. I called for pricing and she’s already giving me attitude within two sentences of the conversation. Needs some customer service training, not to mention when I asked her to repeat herself ONCE she started with “I JUST SAID….”. I was literally asking for the one thing I called for and she acted like I was asking her over and over, I hung up right after that.

It was a great performance grooming business that we went to for a long time. We have several dogs. However, the last year we had a lot of negative experiences: from getting a buzz cut in the winter when we asked for a trim only, to dogs not wanting to go into the place and shaking, to getting a wound during haircut a couple of months ago, to this time we observed how one of the technicians was rough handling the dog.
Coupled with comparatively very high prices - we are now looking for a new groomer.
Very unfortunate as this used to be a great business. Not sure what changed but we are not going back to find out what else can go wrong.
